# Baggett Law Personal Injury Lawyers

> > Jacksonville-based personal injury law firm with 100+ years combined experience representing clients in motor vehicle accidents, catastrophic injuries, and wrongful death claims.

Baggett Law is a Jacksonville, Florida personal injury law firm specializing in car accidents, motorcycle accidents, truck accidents, construction injuries, and wrongful death cases. The firm is known for significant case results and deep community involvement in the Jacksonville area.
